Vintage Mixed Collectibles Lot Viet Nam Embroidered Cloth Pipe Ashtray Knives
This lot includes various vintage collectibles displayed on a blue satin cloth embroidered with a tiger and 'Viet Nam'. Items feature a large dark ceramic novelty pipe ashtray with a tan stem, several miniature metal model cannons and an antique car, a vintage Remington typewriter pencil sharpener, an old telegraph key, and several vintage pocket knives including one branded 'Jim Curran'. Also included is a decorative handled knife in a leather sheath and a boxed OLT game with bird call. All items show signs of age and use, suitable for collectors of eclectic or military-themed memorabilia.
